current.text: Portland added Ja Morant and Jrue Holiday, has Damian Lillard back and gets a full season of Scoot Henderson. All are on-ball guards.
Portland has a new head coach this season.
He is in the projected starting five with Lillard, Morant, Camara and Clingan. Portland is short on forwards, and he and Camara are basically its only forwards.
Experts agree his usage and assists will drop. He becomes the third distributor in the starting group. Projections put his usage at about 24 to 26% and his scoring at about 20 points per game.
His minutes and starting role are seen as safe even as his usage falls.
Minutes and usage across Portland's rotation are expected to swing from game to game.
Experts flag iffy shooting percentages. Lower usage might help his three-point shooting recover.
Experts see fair value around rank 45 to 60 and about 23 USD in an auction. A pick in the mid-30s is too early, and ESPN's 5th place in its category-league ranking makes no sense.
Portland has three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoffs.

durable.text: At his best he is a relentless downhill driver and passer.
His value has depended on huge usage.
Turnovers are his clear weak category. They are a league outlier, so they fit a punt TO build.
He had a back injury late in the 2025-26 season. His play and his three-point shooting dropped after it.

note: Yahoo values him at 24 USD and ranks him 42nd. ESPN values him at only 7 USD, and he went for 17 USD in our league last season. The experts' price of about 20 to 23 USD, around rank 45 to 60, looks right, so do not chase him into the mid-30s. He fits a punt TO build best: his points, rebounds and assists for a G/F stay useful while his 3.3 projected turnovers hurt. Early in the season, check how much usage and how many assists he keeps next to Morant and Lillard, and whether his shooting recovers now that the back injury is behind him.
